jyutping: N cin2 dou3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6

english.note: Use this pattern when the key idea is that the substance has splashed over the surrounding area.

examples.english: The oil splatter got all over the place and made the whole kitchen dirty.
examples.traditional: 啲油濺到周圍都係，搞到成個廚房都污糟晒。
